canonical_project: SSCC Apia cable landing station (Tui-Samoa / Manatua landings)
notes: SSCC RIO effective 1 Jan 2026 defines the Apia cable station and offers colocation/interconnection access guidelines to OOTR-licensed providers; SSCC progress page shows 100% (Tui-Samoa launched Feb 2018 per ADB/OOTR; Manatua Nov 2019). Flexenclosure (trade press, B) supplied eCentre modular data-centre cable landing stations terminating Tui-Samoa at Vavaisse (Upolu, near Apia; ADB IEEA names Fagali'i) and Tuasivi. Classified telecom_cable_station / colo-adjacent interconnection per WS methodology - not a public retail datacenter. SSCC offers Leased Capacity/IRU/Facility Access Agreements.
